title: Quick Indulgent Korean Galangal Pasta
description: A citrusy and crumbly Korean dish featuring galangal paste, served with laminated puff pastry and raw friendly ingredients, this recipe is a unique twist on traditional pasta dishes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a small bowl, mix together the galangal paste, soy sauce, brown sugar, and citrus juice.
Brush the mixture onto the center of the pastry, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the minced garlic, chopped green onions, and sesame seeds over the top of the galangal mixture.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the tops of the pastry with the vegetable oil and sprinkle with Korean chili flakes if using.
Bake the pastry in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the pastry from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
